prompt: How many countries were part of the commonwealth on the date Prince Charles ascended?
answer:
**56 countries** were members of the Commonwealth when Prince Charles became King Charles III on **September 8, 2022**.  

He became head of the Commonwealth, but was head of state in only **14 of those countries**—the Commonwealth realms, including the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.
